outcome: cytokine production in cord blood cells
immune cell populations in cord blood
lymphocyte number in cord venous blood
Th2-related cells in cord venous blood
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women at 24 weeks gestation (N=674) from the Mediterranean NELA birth cohort and their newborns, from whom umbilical cord samples (N=353 vein, N=160 artery) were collected.
finding: Maternal allergies, particularly allergic conjunctivitis, were associated with lower cord vein spermine, and higher cord polyamine levels correlated with increased lymphocyte numbers, reduced Th2-related cells, and lower production of inflammatory and Th2-related cytokines in cord blood.
cross-section timing: Maternal plasma at 24 weeks gestation and umbilical cord samples at birth.
